provenance.rng: np.random.default_rng(SeedSequence([seed, 11])), draw order: private UEs per xApp in xid order (w, gamma_db, service_weight), then boundary UEs per edge in edge order (w, common_gamma_db, service_weight, then per-side gamma jitter left then right)
provenance.weight_dist: w ~ integer uniform {2,...,6}, shared across both sides for boundary UEs
provenance.service_weight: Uniform(0.9, 1.1), shared across both sides for boundary UEs

surrogate_contract.ranking: measurement count descending; utility descending only for equal counts; canonical configuration index ascending
surrogate_contract.empty_noop_candidate: not retained and not used as padding

real_quantum_contract.utility_weight: product of per-item row-shift weights; equivalently exp(lambda * (U-sum(values)) / max(values))
real_quantum_contract.round_policy: calibrated first peak; floor/ceil of continuous optimum
